analysis_method: Read existing frozen manifests and trial predictions; recompute counters and analytic bounds. No new neural inference, training, calibration fitting, or benchmark execution.

analytic_computation.MAC_scope: Single clip; Conv/Linear/query scores/attention pooling only. Excludes FFT, activations, normalization, softmax, bias additions, entity memory and decoder.

calibrator_bound_method: For x_j in [0,1], c(x)=sigmoid(b+sum(w_j*x_j)) <= sigmoid(b+sum(max(0,w_j))). Exhaustive corners verify the linear upper bound; feature correlations can only lower the reachable maximum.

stage_counter_scope: Counts are independently computed conditions on supported references, not a sequential funnel. Saved diagnostic candidates are never accepted production outputs or replacement benchmark scores.

training_protocol.reference_labels: Existing human labels plus exact contract-derived silver synthetic role/value labels; no claim of independently listened synthetic supervision
training_protocol.selection: Human development macro-person accepted exact recall; fewer accepted errors; human micro recall; earlier epoch. Synthetic development reported separately and never substitutes for human selection.
training_protocol.unreviewed_spans: masked; zero acoustic span supervision is reported as a failed qualification gate

unresolved: Relative causal contributions need controlled training/development ablations.
The calibrators reflect the observed calibration data; these bounds do not establish a coding bug in logistic regression or justify forcing confidence upward.
Declared speaker/hash separation does not establish resolved physical cross-source aliases.
Fresh human recordings do not cover all 18 supported intent classes.
Independent listening, selected ncnn/resident-service replay and physical Pi qualification remain incomplete.
user_requirement: Recognize previously unseen human speakers without adding the user voice to fitting, development selection, calibration, or speaker adaptation; preserve benchmark references.
